d:
Hey, the commissioner of the original series of Frisk comics back around what, 8 years ago now? This whole comic series was me giving back to the community at the time for supplying me in my early years with plenty of... ideas and entertainment. At the time I was obsessed with undertale, still am to a much more normal degree, and though "Hey. Why not be a perv and see if I can't find a way to make every enemy hypno flavored?"

Ran out of money before that. Artist and me stayed good friends, we started talking about it again and I brought up the idea of a finale to wrap it all up. And tada, had this finished earlier this year. Figured I'd post it on here, debating on whether to add the original artwork too or not.
